label: Hacker News
agentGuide: No key. Front page: GET /v0/topstories.json (ids; also newstories, beststories, askstories, showstories, jobstories), then GET /v0/item/<id>.json for each (title, url, score, by, time, descendants, kids = comment ids; comments are items of type comment with text). Fetch the first 10-30 ids only, not the whole list. Search and filters go to Algolia: GET https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search?query=<words>&tags=story&hitsPerPage=10 (search_by_date for newest; numericFilters=points>100). A user: GET /v0/user/<name>.json. Link stories as https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=<id>.
